updateContent.title: EhViewer 2.2.0.19 Routing And Relay Precision Fix
content: This required release separates page and image network health so healthy VPN users stay direct-first when possible.
Relay-assisted image recovery no longer makes the client treat the direct lane as healthy, improving cache and fallback decisions.
Older builds are now outside the supported range and should update to 2.2.0.19.
